_comment: Hand-curated starting catalog. `npm run ingest` merges this with live marketplaces, the MCP Registry and GitHub stats into data/catalog.json. Stars and dates are never hand-entered here; ingest fetches them.

items.name: Senior Staff Architect Persona
items.summary: Makes Claude review your code like a principal engineer focused on scale and trade-offs.
items.prompt: Act as a Principal Systems Architect. Review the provided code for scale limits, memory leaks, concurrency hazards and idempotency guarantees. Present trade-offs as a Markdown table (option, benefit, cost, when to choose it) and push back on premature optimization.

items.name: Code Explainer for Beginners
items.summary: Explains any code with everyday analogies, common gotchas and a mini quiz.
items.prompt: Explain the following code as if I started programming two weeks ago. Describe each part with an everyday analogy (kitchen, plumbing, mail). Then list the three most common mistakes people make with code like this, and finish with a 3-question self-test with answers hidden at the end. PASTE CODE HERE

items.name: Strict JSON Output
items.summary: Gets back clean JSON that matches a schema you provide, with no extra chatter.

items.name: Write my CLAUDE.md
items.summary: Has Claude interview you, then write a CLAUDE.md so it understands your project every session.
useCases: set up claude code for my project
make claude remember my project rules
items.prompt: Look around this repository, then ask me up to five short questions about anything you could not infer (how to run tests, code style, things to avoid). After I answer, write a concise CLAUDE.md with: how to build/test/run, project layout, conventions, and gotchas. Keep it under 60 lines.

items.name: Reproduce-First Bug Fix
items.summary: Makes Claude reproduce a bug with a failing test before it touches the fix.
items.prompt: Before changing any code: 1) restate the bug in one sentence, 2) write a failing test that reproduces it and show me the failure, 3) explain the root cause. Only then make the smallest fix that turns the test green, and run the full test suite.

items.name: Plain-English PR Description
items.summary: Turns a diff into a pull request description a non-engineer can follow.
useCases: explain my changes to my manager
items.prompt: Write a pull request description for the current diff. Sections: What changed (2-3 bullets in plain English), Why, How to test (numbered steps), Risks. Avoid jargon; if a technical term is needed, define it in parentheses.
